description: Càmeres tràfic / Cámaras trafico is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Cámaras de tráfico existentes en la ciudad de valencia. - Tipo: Tipo de la cámara web de tráfico, superficie, paso inferior.. - Angulo: Ángulo de representación en el plan. - Idcamara: identificador único de la cámara. - Descrip: Descripción de la orientación de la cámara de tráfico. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Public and state utility services. The portal shows 681 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
